effects.name: guns
effects.note: every gun shot (ev5 with id171 0 or 1; 2 = countermeasure). Strength from id104 (weapon factor: 300i guns 0.031 -> 49 %, Reclaimer turret 0.125 -> 100 %). Replaces ballistic + energy: id171 0/1 flips between shots of the same gun

effects.name: turret_guns
effects.note: turret shot from a remote turret station (ev13 id42 new-shot flag, no ev5), only while ev10 = 2 (turret seat). Session 17: Reclaimer remote station 26 shots, 0 ev5; manned turret shots also have ev5 (guns), shakers take the larger of the two, not the sum; on-foot tractor rifle (ev10 = 0) stays silent

effects.name: boost
effects.note: ev4 id41 = 1 while boost is engaged; only felt while thrust (ev3 id38 magnitude) >= 20 m/s2, so boost without thrust and the planet gear-start pulse stay silent

effects.name: rumble
effects.note: atmospheric speed rumble 0..~0.3

effects.name: hit_rumble
effects.note: the game's own vibration while you are being hit (ev4 id53, 0..1)

effects.name: gear_moving
effects.note: landing gear travelling (id92 = 0.5)

effects.name: decouple
effects.note: decoupled mode toggle

effects.name: heartbeat
effects.note: one thump per ev14 post (1/s); silent at a resting 60 BPM, full at 120 BPM

effects.name: seat_enter
effects.note: sitting down (ev1)

effects.name: seat_exit
effects.note: leaving the seat (ev2)

effects.name: shock
effects.note: collisions, explosions, crash impacts: |ev3 id40| minus own thrust |id38| (max of the last 100 ms), or |id34 - id41|. Boost (id40 = id38 = 254) stays silent; threshold 300 also covers a one-frame lag between id40 and id38 at boost onset; explosion ~1090, fighter bumps 1100-2400, Reclaimer bumps 312-615

effects.name: hit_shield
effects.note: hit absorbed by shields (ev7 id40 > 0); 0.0041 -> 52 %, 0.0101 -> 88 %

effects.name: missile_hit
effects.note: TESTING, to confirm in future (Probable): incoming missile impact. Session 17: one ev7 post with id38 = 3.347e10 (all other ev7 posts have id38 7..159) while a missile hit; id38 is NOT used as an amplitude. Other missile impacts may not carry this signature (Unknown). Fixed strength, no direction

effects.name: destroyed
effects.note: ship lost: ev2 Leave Vehicle while the ship still moved faster than 5 m/s (a normal exit happens landed)

effects.name: missile
effects.note: missile launch (ev6, one post per launch)

effects.name: countermeasure
effects.note: decoy / noise launch (ev5 id171 = 2, id104 = 1)

effects.name: recoil
effects.note: ev13 new-shot flag rising edge (fighter guns and turrets); property only until tuned

effects.name: touchdown
effects.note: ground contact: cHP > threshold with gear down and engines on

effects.name: air_load
effects.note: OFF (Probable): speed x air density; normal flight 30-88, re-entry to 193 -> 0 below 60, full at 200

effects.name: footsteps
effects.note: OFF (Probable): ev16 footstep, strength from id40 (0.14 slow .. 0.64 run)

effects.name: turret_hum
effects.note: OFF (Probable): turret slew rate |ev11 id38| while operating a turret (ev10 = 2)

effects.name: vtol_moving
effects.note: OFF (Probable): VTOL position between 0 and 1
